name: com.universalplatform.BackgroundWorkerConfiguration
comment: Enables database-backed polling workers only on deployments that can keep a worker process alive. Serverless request containers must opt out.

name: com.universalplatform.DatabaseMigrationRunner
comment: One-shot, explicitly invoked database migration entry point. Never run this from any request-serving API instance.  Flyway runs as the schema-owner role. After migrations, this runner grants CRUD access to a separate non-owner application role and configures default privileges so subsequent migrations preserve that role boundary.

name: com.universalplatform.academicreview
comment: Evidence-based academic challenge, discussion, impact analysis, and regrading boundary.

methods.name: requireReviewScope
methods.comment: Org-level managers (tenant-wide REVIEW_MANAGE scope) may resolve any review in the tenant. Other reviewers must share an active enrollment batch (teaching assignment) with the reviewed attempt's learner; closest tenant-scoped check available without a new cross-module API. Regrading is additionally scoped inside {@link com.universalplatform.grading.GradingService}.

name: com.universalplatform.academics.AcademicDirectory
comment: Explicit read-only academic boundary used by curriculum and enrollment modules.

name: com.universalplatform.assessment.AttemptExpiryService
comment: Persists the attempt expiry transition in an independent transaction. The caller (autosave/submit) rejects the write with IllegalArgumentException-free IllegalStateException afterwards, which rolls its own transaction back; without the REQUIRES_NEW commit here the EXPIRED transition would be lost.

methods.name: lockBatchWeight
methods.comment: Serializes the batch weight-sum check across concurrent assignments (advisory lock held until the surrounding transaction commits, closing the read-then-insert race). Idempotent re-assignment of a batch already linked to this assignment skips the lock path entirely.

name: com.universalplatform.communication.AnnouncementWorkerOperation
comment: Durable announcement worker operation that an authorized administrator may replay.

name: com.universalplatform.content.ContentApiExceptionHandler
comment: Maps content/upload domain failures to stable API error codes: validation failures to 400, state conflicts (upload expired, SHA mismatch, downloads disabled, optimistic conflicts) to 409.

name: com.universalplatform.content.ContentRetentionWorker
comment: Purges storage objects of learning resources whose retention window elapsed. Safety rules enforced per version: a version is purgeable only once its grace period passed, its provider object is not referenced by any other version row (reference counted across the tenant), and the object actually leaves provider storage before the version's storage pointer is dropped. Provider failures are retried on the next poll instead of corrupting metadata. {@code ContentRetentionPolicy.retainVersions = true} keeps the newest (current) version object and only purges historical versions; {@code false} purges all versions. A resource whose versions are fully handled is stamped {@code purgedAt} so this poller stops re-scanning it (the previous top-100-oldest query would otherwise head-of-line block forever).

name: com.universalplatform.content.UploadRejectedException
comment: Terminal upload rejection that must be returned to the client without rolling back the ABORTED state.

methods.name: chunkExceedsExpectedLength
methods.comment: Checks a chunk against the remaining upload length without adding untrusted byte counts. Addition can overflow a signed long and turn an oversized chunk into a negative value that passes a naive upper-bound check.

methods.name: realignIfStagingIsAheadOfCommittedOffset
methods.comment: If a previous append committed file bytes but its transaction rolled back, the staging file is longer than the committed {@code receivedBytes}. Re-align the file to the committed offset before appending so a legitimate offset retry cannot produce a corrupt file.

methods.name: finalizeUpload
methods.comment: Idempotent completion: if the session is already COMPLETED, return the storage object it produced instead of re-scanning, re-uploading to the provider, and inserting a duplicate {@link StorageObject}. The check runs under the session's pessimistic row lock.

name: com.universalplatform.content.UploadStagingCleanupService
comment: Marks staging-file cleanup after the filesystem operation succeeds.

name: com.universalplatform.curriculum.CurriculumDirectory
comment: Explicit read-only curriculum boundary used by enrollment and later scheduling modules.

methods.name: validatedJson
methods.comment: Free-text payloads are cast to jsonb columns; reject anything Jackson cannot parse as 400.

name: com.universalplatform.enrollment.EnrollmentDirectory
comment: Explicit read-only batch boundary for later scheduling and live-class modules.

name: com.universalplatform.finance.PaymentProcessingException
comment: A provider-declared authorization/capture failure whose FAILED payment row must commit.

methods.name: compute
methods.comment: Calculates a grade deterministically after applying a versionable policy. Dropped/best-of entries are selected by normalized percentage and the remaining weights are renormalized so a policy cannot silently reduce a learner's grade merely because an item was excluded.

name: com.universalplatform.gradebook.GradebookPolicy
comment: Immutable, deterministic policy for advanced grade calculation.

name: com.universalplatform.grading
comment: Immutable grading history and result publication boundary.

methods.name: answerScore
methods.comment: Latest revision's final score of a single graded item across all revisions of the attempt (0 when ungraded).

methods.name: requireAttemptScope
methods.comment: Org-level managers (tenant-wide GRADING_MANAGE scope) may grade any attempt in the tenant. Other graders must share an active enrollment batch (teaching assignment) with the attempt's learner; this is the closest tenant-scoped check available without a new cross-module API.

name: com.universalplatform.identity.FederationIdentityDirectory
comment: Public identity boundary for trusted enterprise-federation claim synchronization.

name: com.universalplatform.identity.LocalDevelopmentIdentityBootstrapper
comment: Creates/reuses the local owner as normal persisted UEP identity data. The application still resolves permissions and tenant context through its existing identity and authorization services.

name: com.universalplatform.identity.MembershipDirectory
comment: Explicit read-only identity boundary for other domain modules.

name: com.universalplatform.integration.DatabaseTenantStorageBindingResolver
comment: Resolves configured provider bindings from the integration module's authoritative tenant table.

methods.name: payloadFor
methods.comment: Provider-specific payload shape (C12): HTTP_JSON keeps {"title","body"}; SLACK_WEBHOOK and TEAMS_WEBHOOK require {"text": ...}.

name: com.universalplatform.integration.OutboundEndpointValidator
comment: Blocks outbound HTTP endpoints that resolve to non-public addresses.  Validation must run at configuration time and again immediately before delivery. Network-level egress policy is still required to eliminate DNS rebinding/TOCTOU races between resolution and socket connection.

methods.name: enqueueIfAbsent
methods.signature: enqueueIfAbsent(java.util.UUID, java.util.UUID, java.util.UUID, java.util.UUID, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.time.Instant)
methods.comment: Idempotent enqueue at the database uniqueness boundary. A duplicate event is a no-op, while genuine SQL/connection failures propagate to the publisher.

name: com.universalplatform.integration.WebhookEventFanoutWorker
comment: Expands durable source events into per-subscription deliveries. Delivery intent and the processed marker are committed atomically; HTTP transport remains the responsibility of WebhookWorker.

methods.name: processOne
methods.comment: Public within the module for integration tests; every event gets an independent transaction.

name: com.universalplatform.integration.WebhookEventOutboxService
comment: Stores webhook fan-out work in the transaction that publishes the source notification event. This queue records intent only; network delivery is delegated to WebhookEventFanoutWorker.

name: com.universalplatform.integration.WebhookNotificationListener
comment: Transactional event bridge: persist fan-out intent, never call the remote webhook here. The outbox row shares the source notification transaction and survives application restarts.

methods.name: publish
methods.comment: User-invoked publish (e.g. /webhooks/test): guarded by the same permission as webhook management.

name: com.universalplatform.integration.WebhookWorkerLock
comment: Cross-instance worker coordination for webhook deliveries, mirroring scheduling's ScheduleWriteLock: a transaction-scoped advisory lock keyed by tenant id. Must be acquired inside an active transaction.

methods.name: liveClassIdsForBatches
methods.comment: IDs of live classes the given batches attend; read-only lookup for sibling modules (e.g. recording listing scoping).

name: com.universalplatform.liveclass.LiveMediaProvider
comment: Provider-neutral media control boundary used by the live-class domain.

name: com.universalplatform.notification.NotificationDedupLock
comment: Serializes concurrent enqueues of the same deduplication key inside the caller's transaction. Mirrors {@code com.universalplatform.scheduling.ScheduleWriteLock}: a PostgreSQL transactional advisory lock keyed by tenant + key is taken only after a fast-path miss, closing the read-then-insert race without relying on catching a unique-constraint violation (which would poison the joined business transaction). The lock is released automatically at commit/rollback, and the {@code uq_notification_outbox_tenant_dedup} unique constraint remains the final backstop.

name: com.universalplatform.notification.NotificationDirectory
comment: Read-only notification boundary for dashboard composition.

name: com.universalplatform.notification.NotificationEmailWorker
comment: Sends pending email deliveries through SMTP. Each delivery is attempted inside its own transaction via {@link TransactionTemplate} so the pessimistic lock applies and SENT / FAILED / DEAD_LETTERED transitions with backoff state actually persist (invoking a proxied {@code @Transactional} method from {@code poll()} would bypass the transaction entirely and re-send the same email on every poll).

methods.name: sendOne
methods.comment: Public for tests; executes the per-delivery work in a separate transaction each call.

name: com.universalplatform.notification.NotificationOutboxProcessor
comment: Materializes due outbox events into per-recipient notifications and email deliveries. Each due event is processed inside its own transaction via {@link TransactionTemplate} so the pessimistic row lock and the processed/failed state transitions actually persist (a self-invoked {@code @Transactional} method from {@code poll()} would bypass the proxy).

methods.name: processOne
methods.comment: Public for tests; executes the per-event work in a separate transaction each call.

name: com.universalplatform.notification.NotificationPublisher
comment: Public durable-notification boundary used by domain modules inside their business transaction.

name: com.universalplatform.organization.OrganizationDirectory
comment: Explicit read-only organization boundary for other domain modules.

name: com.universalplatform.presence.AttendanceCalculator
comment: Deterministic attendance-policy evaluation kept independent of persistence and transport.

methods.name: actualSessionSpanSeconds
methods.comment: Actual session span in seconds: earliest participant join .. class end (or now when still running). Falls back to the live-class start, then the scheduled window.

methods.name: esc
methods.comment: Proper JSON string escaping: quotes, backslashes and control characters (JWT claims and request bodies).

methods.name: markFinalizing
methods.comment: Strict state machine: finalizing is only valid from states where recording output may still be in flight (STARTING/RECORDING).

methods.name: writeReservedObject
methods.signature: writeReservedObject(java.util.UUID, com.universalplatform.storage.StorageProviderType, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, long, java.lang.String, com.universalplatform.recording.RecordingService$RecordingInputStream, com.universalplatform.storage.StorageAdapter, java.util.function.Consumer)
methods.comment: Reserves capacity before the destination request. A failure before PUT starts is safe to release; a failure after PUT starts but before a locator is returned is ambiguous and must remain charged for operator reconciliation. Once a locator is known, failed finalization compensates it immediately (or persists a cleanup outbox job).

methods.name: sha256
methods.comment: SHA-256 of a file, hex encoded.

methods.name: archive
methods.comment: Keyset pagination prevents an old ARCHIVING row from starving later recordings.

name: com.universalplatform.recording.RecordingWorkerLock
comment: Cross-instance worker coordination for recording jobs, mirroring scheduling's ScheduleWriteLock: a transaction-scoped advisory lock keyed by tenant id. Must be acquired inside an active transaction (the lock is released when that transaction commits or rolls back).

name: com.universalplatform.scheduling.ScheduleDirectory
comment: Read-only scheduling boundary used by dashboards and later presence/media modules.

methods.name: findRangeCapped
methods.comment: Same overlap query as {@link #findRange} but bounded in SQL via the supplied pageable (LIMIT).

methods.name: findRangeForTeacherCapped
methods.comment: Capped variant of {@link #findRangeForTeacher}.

methods.name: findRangeForBatchesCapped
methods.comment: Capped variant of {@link #findRangeForBatches}.

methods.name: findRangeForCoursesCapped
methods.comment: Capped variant of {@link #findRangeForCourses}.

methods.name: findRangeForSubjectsCapped
methods.comment: Capped variant of {@link #findRangeForSubjects}.

methods.name: findRangeForModulesCapped
methods.comment: Capped variant of {@link #findRangeForModules}.

methods.name: findPublicRangeCapped
methods.comment: Capped variant of {@link #findPublicRange}.

methods.name: findRangeForBranchesCapped
methods.comment: Capped variant of {@link #findRangeForBranches}.

name: com.universalplatform.security.ApiCredentialAuthorizer
comment: Narrow authorization port used by API credential lifecycle operations.  Keeping permission names out of this port avoids a compile-time dependency from the security package back into the identity module.

methods.name: requireApiCredentialTarget
methods.comment: Validate that credential issuance cannot silently impersonate another tenant member.

name: com.universalplatform.security.LocalDevelopmentAuthenticationFilter
comment: Local-only authentication for a Vite frontend connected to the actual API.  The launcher supplies a random, short-lived token. It is accepted only for loopback requests in the explicit local-native Spring profile; it is not a JWT validation bypass and is never enabled by the default/prod profiles.

name: com.universalplatform.security.LocalNativeJwtDecoderConfiguration
comment: Prevents the local-native backend from performing remote OIDC issuer discovery. LocalDevelopmentAuthenticationFilter is the only interactive auth mechanism in this profile.

name: com.universalplatform.security.ProductionSecretGuard
comment: Fails application startup when a deployment still runs any secret at its public development-default value (from apps/platform-server/src/main/resources/application.yaml). Two escapes exist and both are intentional: {@code platform.development-mode} (env {@code PLATFORM_DEV_MODE}) for local development/CI, and test-harness detection so {@code @SpringBootTest} boots (which intentionally boot the shipped dev defaults) complete. The detection fails closed: a real production boot never has JUnit/Spring-Test frames on the startup stack, so it is always guarded regardless of the dev default being publicly documented.

methods.name: validateProductionSecrets
methods.comment: Validates without the test-harness bypass so the fail-closed contract can be unit-tested. Values are never included in errors; only property/environment variable names are reported.

methods.name: validateProductionOidcConfiguration
methods.comment: The resource-server issuer and JWKS endpoint are trust anchors. A production deployment must never fall back to the sample localhost HTTP endpoints. Values are deliberately excluded from diagnostics to avoid leaking URLs that may contain deployment-specific routing information.

methods.name: runningUnderTestHarness
methods.comment: Test contexts boot the main application.yaml on purpose (no separate test properties file), so defaults like {@code education} are the intended development state there.

name: com.universalplatform.security.ScopedCredentialPrincipal
comment: Authentication principal supplied by a tenant-scoped API credential.

name: com.universalplatform.security.SecurityPlatformAdministratorGuard
comment: Security-module adapter for the tenancy module's platform-administration port. It checks the authenticated Keycloak realm role without introducing a dependency from the identity module back into tenancy.

name: com.universalplatform.security.TenantExecutionContext
comment: Establishes a bounded tenant context for trusted background jobs that operate from persisted tenant-owned work.

name: com.universalplatform.security.TenantLifecycleFilter
comment: Blocks API access for tenants whose lifecycle state does not permit it: SUSPENDED/CLOSED -> all requests denied; READ_ONLY -> only safe methods allowed; unknown tenant ids -> denied (fallback-deny). Only {@code ACTIVE} status (the hot path) is cached briefly (30s); deny-decisions are looked up live so a suspended tenant never rejoins traffic through a stale cache entry. Background workers that act on persisted tenant-owned work wrap with TenantExecutionContext and do not traverse HTTP filters, so tenant-scoped jobs remain unaffected.

name: com.universalplatform.security.TenantMutationLock
comment: Serializes tenant-wide identity invariants within the caller's database transaction. The lock is held until that transaction commits or rolls back.

name: com.universalplatform.serialization.Jackson2CompatibilityConfiguration
comment: Compatibility mapper for code that still uses Jackson 2 types.  Spring Boot 4 configures Jackson 3 by default. The platform's assessment, grading, and integration adapters currently use Jackson 2's ObjectMapper and JsonNode APIs, so expose a separately typed bean instead of silently relying on the HTTP message-converter mapper.

name: com.universalplatform.storage.StorageCleanupQueue
comment: Cross-module boundary for durable deletion of provider objects.

methods.name: enqueueWithinCurrentTransaction
methods.comment: Enlist cleanup in the caller's transaction so metadata retirement and the durable provider-deletion request commit or roll back together.

name: com.universalplatform.storage.StorageQuotaException
comment: A storage capacity or provider-policy rejection with an actionable HTTP response.

name: com.universalplatform.storage.StorageQuotaReconciliationWorker
comment: Reports ledger/aggregate drift without silently rewriting accounting history.

name: com.universalplatform.storage.StorageQuotaService
comment: Persistent storage-capacity ledger. Reservations and aggregates are changed in one transaction; provider and tenant rows are locked in a fixed order so concurrent uploads cannot over-allocate. This deliberately does not use the daily usage_counter table.

methods.name: reserveDurable
methods.comment: Persists a reservation independently of an enclosing worker transaction before remote I/O.

methods.name: consumeProviderOperations
methods.comment: Persist a conservative provider operation charge before the external HTTP request. The S3 client is configured for at most three attempts, so callers reserve three billable requests per logical PUT/GET even when the first attempt succeeds.

methods.name: consumeProviderDeleteOperations
methods.comment: Object deletion remains available after a provider is read/write-disabled so cleanup can reduce stored bytes and costs. It is still charged against the Class A operation budget.

methods.name: release
methods.comment: Releases a reservation or committed object exactly once. The caller must invoke this only after the external provider has confirmed deletion, or when a pre-upload reservation is aborted/expired. Repeated cleanup retries are harmless.

methods.name: releaseDurable
methods.comment: Release from afterCommit/afterCompletion callbacks in a transaction of its own.

methods.name: staleRecordingReservations
methods.comment: Finds recording/migration reservations that outlived the normal provider write window. These are deliberately reported, never auto-released: a timed-out PUT may have succeeded remotely even when the application did not receive its locator.

methods.name: requireWithinBudget
methods.comment: An atomic conditional quota update intentionally affects zero rows when the limit is exhausted. That is a domain rejection, not a ledger-corruption condition.

name: com.universalplatform.storage.TenantStorageBinding
comment: Immutable storage provider and object prefix snapshot selected for an upload session.

name: com.universalplatform.storage.TenantStorageBindingResolver
comment: Resolves the server-owned storage destination configured for a tenant. Implementations belong to the module that owns tenant integration bindings.

name: com.universalplatform.tenancy.LocalTenantBootstrapService
comment: Owns the one local demonstration tenant used when the native launcher runs without an external identity provider. This is never active outside the explicit local-native Spring profile.

name: com.universalplatform.tenancy.PlatformAdministratorGuard
comment: Consumer-owned port for protecting cross-tenant control-plane operations. The identity module supplies the implementation using the authenticated OIDC realm roles.
